Indigo-scaled great wyrm, nigh-endless. Content to watch the universe, only interfering when needed.

AC 16, HP 61, ATK 3 rend +9 (2d10) or 1 time breath, MV double near (fly), S +4, D +0, C +3, I +3, W +4, Ch +3, AL N, LV 13

Frostblood. Cold immune.

Starflight. Dragon and riders can survive the interstellar void. Able to fly between worlds in 1d4 days.

Time Breath. A double near- size cube of fragrant dust extending from the dragon. CON 15+ or age 1d100 years (younger or older), cease to exist at 0 years old or die of old age if past elderly.

Time Travel. Travel to a different time, can bring willing creatures.
